/* Film and television */ Her first lead was in ''[[Wicked (1998 film)|Wicked]]'' (1998), in which we played a teenage girl who might have murdered her mother so she could have her father all to herself. Critic Joe Baltake wrote she was "the darling of the 1998 [[Sundance Film Festival]].

Her film debut was a small role at age 15 in ''[[I Love You, I Love You Not]]'' (1996), followed by a lead role in [[Wicked (1998 film)|''Wicked'']] (1998) for which she received the [[Karlovy Vary International Film Festival|Karlovy Vary Film Festival Award for Best Actress]]. She rose to prominence with leading roles in teen films such as ''[[10 Things I Hate About You]]'' (1999), ''[[Down to You]]'' (2000), and ''[[Save the Last Dance]]'' (2001).
